title: In EDB Postgres Extended Server and EDB Postgres Advanced Server versions 15 through 18 with Transparent Data…
description: EDB Postgres Extended Server and EDB Postgres Advanced Server versions 15 through 18 with Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) enabled have a vulnerability where the key used to encrypt temporary files is incompletely initialized. This results in only 8 bytes of the intended 32-byte key being securely randomized, reducing the key's effective randomness from 256 bits to 64 bits. Exploitation requires local read access to the server's temporary-file directory. Permanent data files and WAL are not affected. The issue is fixed in versions 15.20, 16.16, 17.12, and 18.7 (and their respective 15.20.0, 16.16.0, 17.12.0, 18.7.0 variants), with a server restart required after upgrading.
